description: Typed graph-node overrides and aliases for the current 77-card survey. This file does not create or change evidence-bearing relations.
integration_order: Create default nodes from model-card ids.
Overlay nodes below by id; card_id links shared cards without asserting identity of the split components.
For each raw relation apply matching relation_endpoint_overrides before generic aliases.
Resolve aliases once and retain the original relation_type, evidence_type, explanation and source_ids.
Reject unresolved endpoints and self-loops after normalization; render model families, methods, implementations, benchmarks and design patterns distinctly.

relation_endpoint_overrides.reason: The combined source card covers ER1.5 and VLA1.5; this particular successor edge is explicitly the ER branch.
The cited reuse is the OXE dataset, not RT-X policy weights.
The cited reuse is the OXE dataset, not RT-X policy weights.
The explicit variant is the pi0-FAST policy; FAST alone denotes the tokenizer.

notes: Do not apply gemini-robotics15 -> gemini-er15 as a global alias: other edges genuinely refer to the VLA branch.
Grouped-card container nodes may be retained for catalog navigation or hidden from a relation-only view when isolated; the constituent nodes are the relation endpoints.
S1 is resolved to Skild S1 only because every current bare-S1 edge is sourced from H021/H022. Figure System1 would need its own unambiguous id if added later.
GEN-1, GEN-1.5, Molmo2-ER and GOAT-Bench are context nodes without independent current cards. Their presence in this graph is not a claim that complete model cards exist.
Contextual endpoint disambiguation does not turn analytical similarity, composition or dataset reuse into weight inheritance.
